## Description
Summary of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update / Refactoring

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the PEP8 style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have formatted my code using `ruff format .`
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes cleanly with 0 errors
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes (`make test`)
- [ ] I have updated documentation accordingly
